judge.rationale: The candidate satisfies all acceptance criteria: it wraps non-Error rejections in an `Error` with `cause` set to the original value, preserves existing `Error` instances unchanged, re-throws the original rejection, updates `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` (plus line-number links in related specs), and documents the change in `CHANGELOG.md`. For the wrapper's message, the candidate uses `String(error)` directly whereas the reference prefers `JSON.stringify` with a fallback to `String(error)` so plain objects don't become `"[object Object]"`. Additionally, the candidate leaves behind a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file and splits the tests across `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` and a separate `onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts` file, whereas the reference keeps all tests cleanly within `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
